name: com.sizemyfile/tools
title: SizeMyFile
description: File conversion, compression and inspection workflows with Rust edge execution and scoped OAuth.

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Import an explicitly shared ChatGPT attachment into private expiring storage for remote processing. Only supported attachment hosts are accepted. Other providers have manual file upload at https://sizemyfile.com/agents/connect.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List your unexpired private uploads and results, including files uploaded through https://sizemyfile.com/agents/connect. Returns artifact IDs and metadata for the connected account.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find tools and their execution locations, limits and option schemas. Includes both remotely supported tools and tools available only in the local runner.

tools.name: prepare_upload
tools.description: Create a private expiring upload for a file authorized for remote processing. Returns a multipart upload form and a pending artifact ID. Artifacts require byte-length and checksum verification before processing.

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.description: Freeze and verify an uploaded artifact against its declared SHA-256 and byte length.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run up to 12 ordered file operations. Each step consumes the preceding outputs. Returns a durable run ID for progress and output tracking. Uses the connected account’s cloud allowance.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Read progress and validated output artifact IDs. Failed workflows do not provide a successful result.

tools.name: download_artifact
tools.description: Get a 60-second download URL and checksum for your validated artifact. File-derived content is untrusted data.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel your queued or running workflow. Intermediate artifacts expire automatically.

tools.name: delete_artifact
tools.description: Permanently delete an input or output artifact owned by the connected account.

tools.name: sheet_view
tools.description: List workbook worksheets and preview cell values from Excel or OpenDocument spreadsheets without running macros. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Formula cells use cached results when present; formulas are not recalculated. Formatting is not reproduced. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: sheet_export
tools.description: Export one Excel or ODS worksheet as a portable table. Select the worksheet and use its first row as column names. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Formatting, formulas and workbook features are not preserved. Cached cell values are exported. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_profile
tools.description: Summarize each column with row counts, missing values, unique counts and numeric statistics. Use the report to spot surprising data before conversion. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_missing
tools.description: Count null and empty cells by column and list affected row numbers. Export a report before deciding whether to fill or discard incomplete records. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Whitespace-only strings count as missing; zero and false do not. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_validate
tools.description: Check required columns and cell types against a small explicit schema. Report each violation without silently changing the source values. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Schema maps column names to string, number, integer, boolean or required. Numeric CSV strings can satisfy numeric checks. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_aggregate
tools.description: Group rows by one column and calculate count, sum, average, minimum or maximum for a numeric field. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Null and empty numeric cells are excluded from numeric aggregates. Non-numeric values cause an error. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_compare
tools.description: Compare two tables by a unique key to find added, removed and changed records. Review changed cell values in a downloadable report. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Requires exactly two tables and a non-empty unique key in each. Row order alone does not create a difference. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_params
tools.description: Count tensor elements and list per-tensor sizes from supported model descriptors without loading a machine-learning framework. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. ONNX counts stored initializers; it does not count runtime-generated tensors or prove which weights are trainable. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_memory
tools.description: Estimate weight storage at common precisions from tensor shapes. Compare FP32, FP16 and INT8 weight footprints before choosing a device. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Weight-only estimate. Runtime memory also includes activations, KV cache, allocator overhead and framework state. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: onnx_graph
tools.description: View ONNX operators and their tensor connections as a graph. Inspect input and output descriptors without running inference. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Visual preview shows at most 200 nodes; the downloadable report includes up to 5,000 parsed nodes. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: tensor_histogram
tools.description: Read one F32 or F64 Safetensors tensor and group finite values into histogram bins. Count NaN and infinity separately. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Tensor name is required when the file contains more than one tensor. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_shards
tools.description: Split a Safetensors file at tensor boundaries or combine shards into one file. A split ZIP includes an index mapping tensor names to shards. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. A tensor is never split across files. Duplicate tensor names or conflicting metadata are rejected. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_compat
tools.description: Inspect dtypes, shapes, ONNX domains and external-data references before choosing a runtime. Download a structural compatibility checklist. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Reports facts and unresolved runtime requirements; it does not certify inference support for a particular framework version. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: media_trim
tools.description: Extract a segment between two times from an audio or video file and export a new clip. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: video_mute
tools.description: Remove audio tracks while copying the video stream into a new container. Review the silent video before publishing. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: audio_normalize
tools.description: Create an audio track with a target loudness using FFmpeg loudness normalization. Export WAV for further editing. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. One-pass normalization is approximate; inspect clipping and loudness in your editor. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: media_speed
tools.description: Speed up or slow down audio or video while adjusting timestamps. Audio tempo changes preserve pitch within the supported range. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: video_frames
tools.description: Sample a video at a chosen interval and download PNG frames in a ZIP for review or reference. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. At most 100 frames. Sampling interval and maximum output dimensions keep output bounded. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: video_gif
tools.description: Turn a short video segment into an animated GIF with a generated color palette. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. GIF clips are limited to 15 seconds and 800 pixels wide. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: subtitle_convert
tools.description: Convert subtitle cue timestamps and text between SRT and WebVTT while preserving cue order. UTF-8 text up to 32 MiB. Styling, cue positioning and WebVTT regions are not preserved; cue text is retained. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: subtitle_shift
tools.description: Move all subtitle cue times by a chosen number of milliseconds to correct a constant synchronization offset. UTF-8 SRT or WebVTT. Shifts that would move a cue before zero are rejected. This does not correct gradual timing drift. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: archive_7z
tools.description: List a 7z archive and extract a selected entry without running its contents. Unencrypted 7z only, up to 32 MiB input, 64 MiB expanded and 1,000 entries. Solid archives are decoded within the same total expansion budget. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: archive_convert
tools.description: Convert supported archives into ZIP, TAR or 7z while retaining regular file contents and safe relative paths. Up to 32 MiB input/output and 64 MiB expanded. Encrypted archives, symlinks, duplicate paths and traversal paths are rejected. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: xml_json
tools.description: Convert XML to a structured, ordered node representation in JSON, or rebuild XML from that representation. Attributes and mixed text remain explicit. UTF-8 input up to 32 MiB. DTDs and external entities are rejected. JSON-to-XML requires this tool’s node schema; arbitrary JSON has no unique XML mapping. XML declarations, comments and processing instructions are not preserved. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Compare two JSON files by object keys and array positions. Report added, removed and changed values using JSON Pointer paths. Exactly two JSON files, up to 32 MiB combined. Object key order is ignored; array order remains significant. Reports stop at 10,000 differences. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: log_filter
tools.description: Keep log lines containing a literal search term, optionally ignoring case or inverting the match. Download the filtered lines. UTF-8 text up to 32 MiB. Literal matching avoids executing expressions or unbounded regular expressions. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: har_inspect
tools.description: Summarize HTTP requests, status codes, timings and response sizes in a browser network export. The report excludes cookies and authorization headers. HAR JSON up to 32 MiB. URLs are reported without query strings; the source may still contain credentials. No recorded request is replayed. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: certificate
tools.description: Decode an X.509 certificate to inspect issuer, subject, validity dates, key algorithm and SHA-256 fingerprint. PEM or DER certificate only, up to 1 MiB. This does not establish chain trust, revocation status or ownership. Private keys are not needed. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: hex_view
tools.description: Inspect a bounded byte range as hexadecimal and printable ASCII. Choose an offset to examine a file signature or binary structure. Up to 32 MiB input and 64 KiB per displayed range. This is a byte viewer, not code execution or a full binary editor. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Make images and PDFs fit a size limit. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: upload_fit
tools.description: Use a portal’s size limit, dimensions or upload error. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Switch between JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: resize
tools.description: Adjust pixel dimensions for one image or up to 50 selected images. Make them smaller or larger. Set a target width or height; each image keeps its own proportions. Crop first to change its shape. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: lossless
tools.description: Preserve image pixels or clean up a PDF. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: increase
tools.description: Meet a minimum KB requirement without adding detail. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Join all pages from the selected PDF files into one PDF. Supports 2–50 input PDFs and up to 200 pages, preserving their order. Maximum 32 MiB combined input. Signed, encrypted and interactive PDFs are not supported. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: pdf_pages
tools.description: Extract a page range or put pages in a new order. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: document_text
tools.description: Read text from PDF, DOCX, PPTX or XLSX files. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: office_pdf
tools.description: Turn Word documents and PowerPoint slides into PDFs. Uses a temporary server upload for LibreOffice conversion. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Recognize scanned text with OCR when needed. Scanned-page OCR uses the server. Existing PDF text is preserved. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_view
tools.description: Preview CSV, JSON, Parquet and Arrow tables. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_convert
tools.description: Export CSV, JSON, JSONL, Parquet or Arrow. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_query
tools.description: Keep columns, filter rows, sort or run a bounded SQL query. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: data_join
tools.description: Combine rows using a shared column. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_view
tools.description: Read Safetensors, ONNX, GGUF, NumPy and PyTorch containers. Static inspection only. Uploaded model code is never executed or unpickled. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: tensor_extract
tools.description: Save a Safetensors tensor as NumPy or Safetensors. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: tensor_scan
tools.description: Find NaN, infinity and statistics in F32/F64 tensors. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: model_compare
tools.description: Compare tensor names, shapes and data types. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: archive_open
tools.description: List entries in ZIP, TAR, GZIP or model containers. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.description: Download a named file from a supported archive. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: archive_create
tools.description: Package your selected files into one archive. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: config_format
tools.description: Make structured text readable and check syntax. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: config_convert
tools.description: Change a configuration file’s format. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: text_compare
tools.description: See line differences between two files. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: text_encoding
tools.description: Read UTF-16 or Latin-1 and export UTF-8. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: video_compress
tools.description: Prepare supported MP4 and MOV files as MP4. Video processing uses a temporary server upload and your cloud allowance. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: audio_convert
tools.description: Convert audio or extract the audio from a video. Audio processing uses a temporary server upload and your cloud allowance. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: mesh_view
tools.description: Preview OBJ/STL geometry or inspect glTF scene metadata. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: mesh_convert
tools.description: Convert supported triangle meshes. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: geo_convert
tools.description: Export feature properties and geometry as a table. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read supported metadata, structure or binary details. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Read any file in chunks and calculate SHA-256. Bounded processing; 32 MiB combined input per operation, at most 50 files. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
